title: An infinite APN family containing sporadic representative 30
summary: Generalize sporadic APN representative number 30 over nine binary dimensions into an infinite trivariate APN family.

formal_statement.body: Over $\mathbb F_{2^3}^3\cong\mathbb F_2^9$, let $R_{30}(x,y,z)=(x^3+xz^2+yz^2+z^3,\ x^2y+x^2z+z^3,\ x^2z+y^3)$. Construct an explicit family $F_m:\mathbb F_{2^m}^3\to\mathbb F_{2^m}^3$ for infinitely many extension degrees $m$, prove every $F_m$ is APN, and prove that the $m=3$ specialization is CCZ-equivalent to $R_{30}$.

scope.domain: Infinite trivariate APN generalizations of a fixed sporadic nine-dimensional representative
assumptions: The base function is the displayed non-permutation representative number 30 over $\mathbb F_2^9$
The generalization retains a trivariate representation over $\mathbb F_{2^m}^3$
Every member must be proved APN
scope.unresolved_remainder: The source gives only the sporadic $m=3$ instance. No inspected later construction proves an infinite trivariate APN family specializing to representative number 30.

citations.label: Li--Kaleyski, Two New Infinite Families of APN Functions in Trivariate Form
citations.locator: Section V-C, displayed representative 30 and following sentence, journal p. 1450

progress.summary: The source identifies a trivariate representative in the sporadic number-30 class and leaves its extension to an infinite APN family open.
